stories.title: Plan to cut unnecessary traffic in Chester city centre to be reviewed by councillors next week
stories.summary: A radical rethink in how people travel around Chester is set to be reviewed by council chiefs. Cheshire West and Chester Council is currently working on the Chester Movement Strategy, which will set out a long-term plan for how people travel in, to, and around the city up to 2045. stories.title: Mold care home nurse struck off after obtaining 99-year-old resident’s house and money
stories.summary: A nurse who was deputy manager of a Mold care home has been struck off after a disciplinary panel found she took a 99-year-old resident’s house and money through manipulation or coercion. stories.title: School leaders in Wales to be balloted for industrial action as pay talks collapse
stories.summary: School leaders across Wales are to be balloted for industrial action after their union pulled out of talks with the Welsh Government over pay and workload. stories.title: Chester Christmas security measures: bollard closures and blue badge changes from 18 November
stories.summary: Chester’s central streets will close to vehicles from 10.30am every day from 18 November, as the city’s Christmas market opens.
